content.short: Reality Rush is a TON city-building game on Telegram where players expand districts, complete tasks, and earn rewards.
content.description: Reality Rush is a city-building game from Reality Metaverse that runs through a Telegram Mini App and connects to TON. Players begin with a small setup, place landmarks, collect RP, upgrade city services, and complete tasks that help accelerate progression. Official materials present it as a structured builder with social referrals, prize campaigns, and RRUSH token incentives, giving the game more depth than a lightweight tap driven reward loop and a clearer progression system for returning players.
content.meta: Reality Rush brings city-building gameplay and reward progression to TON on Telegram.
